summary: Reject expired tokens at the ingest endpoint

user_story.capability: the ingest endpoint to reject expired tokens with a 401
user_story.benefit: a stale client fails loudly instead of writing under a revoked identity

context: Ingest currently checks the token signature but not its expiry, so a revoked client keeps writing until its key rotates. Expiry is already present in the claim set.
acceptance_criteria: A request carrying an expired token returns 401 and writes nothing
A request carrying a valid token is unaffected
The rejection is logged with the client id and the expiry timestamp

test_plan.title: Expired token is rejected
steps: Mint a token with an expiry in the past
Assert 401 and assert no row was written
